reader_summary.overview: Thomas spent the last decade in the strategy with the same team, a prior decade in emerging markets research. Our conversation covers Thomas' path to investing, the opportunity set and misconceptions of hard currency debt, and his team's approach to the sector. This is our third sponsored insight from Janus Henderson, following conversations with Daniel Grana on emerging market equities and Andy Acker on biotech.
